title: Out-of-bounds read in the QAuthenticator NTLM authentication handling in the Qt Network module in Qt Group Qt allows…
description: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability exists in the QAuthenticator NTLM authentication handling within the Qt Network module. This flaw allows remote attackers to read sensitive heap memory or cause application crashes by sending a crafted NTLM challenge. The issue affects applications using QNetworkAccessManager or QTcpSocket with NTLM authentication.
